'''Sector 11'''<ref name="BMF 73" /> was one of the twenty [[oversector]]s of the [[Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire]]. Sectors 7-12 made up the northern quadrant of [[the galaxy]].<ref name="BMF 18">{{BuildFalconCite|18|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> A [[Unidentified Haven-class medical station|''Haven''-class medical station]] in Sector 11 was visited by members of the [[Spectres]].<ref name="BMF 73" />
